verified_metadata.venue: Proceedings of the 39th International Conference on Machine Learning, PMLR 162

metadata_sources.supports: Title, ordered authors, venue/publication status and year.
Full paper §§3–4: conservation analysis, AH-rule, LN-rule and implementation box.

artifact.version_note: Official published full text; title and ordered authors read and matched.

contexts.evidence: §§3–4 introduce conservative transformer LRP.
§4 supplies conservative attention-head and LayerNorm propagation.
§4, pp.4–5 freezes attention and the LayerNorm denominator; centering remains differentiable.
contexts.proposed_replacement: Transformer-specific rules therefore \emph{condition} on parts of the forward pass: conservative propagation~\parencite{Ali2022AttnLRP} holds $A$ and the LayerNorm denominator fixed while retaining the linear centering operation; DAVE~\parencite{Wrobel2024} also fixes the mean. Both route attention relevance through the Value path only; AttnLRP~\parencite{Achtibat2024AttnLRP} also propagates through the softmax and the QK product.

contexts.evidence: §3 proves nonconservation; §4 detaches attention and variance scaling, not the mean.
contexts.proposed_replacement: \textcite{Ali2022AttnLRP} made the structural point that shapes this chapter: naive gradient propagation through attention and layer normalization \emph{violates conservation}, whereas holding the attention matrix and LayerNorm denominator constant (``detached), while retaining linear centering, restores it.

contexts.evidence: §4 AH-rule treats realized attention as fixed coefficients.
§4 AH-rule freezes attention, yielding linear Value routing.
§4 leaves LayerNorm centering active, so its map is linear but not pointwise.
contexts.proposed_replacement: LayerNorm's mean and denominator are detached following DAVE~\parencite{Wrobel2024}, so the layer becomes a pointwise affine map; Ali et al.~\parencite{Ali2022AttnLRP} instead detach only the denominator and retain linear centering.

contexts.evidence: §4 AH-rule freezes attention and disconnects Query/Key propagation.
§3.2 Proposition 3.2 establishes LayerNorm nonconservation; the subsequent DAVE implementation is a separate attribution.
§4 AH-rule supports the stated Value-only conditioned attention comparison.
§4 AH-rule assigns no relevance to attention-generating Query/Key paths.

notes: Citation key says AttnLRP, but this is Ali et al.’s conservative propagation paper, not Achtibat et al.’s distinct AttnLRP. Identity and metadata are correct.
Attention detachment is supported. LayerNorm treatment differs from freezing both mean and variance: only its denominator is detached, retaining linear centering.

contexts.evidence: Theorem 1 and §§3–4 study identifiability up to permutations/scalings via piecewise-linear folds. They do not prove CPWL/ReLU representation equivalence or a tropical-rational characterization.
contexts.proposed_replacement: The geometric reading rests on the identification of \ac{relu} networks with \ac{cpwl} maps and tropical rational functions \parencite{Arora2018,Zhang2018,BalestrieroBaraniuk2018MadMax,Montufar2022,Misiakos2022,Hertrich2023,huchette2025deeplearningmeetspolyhedral}.

notes: The paper is relevant to ReLU geometry broadly, but removing this one key from the representation-equivalence citation cluster is the minimal precise correction; no claim about its actual theorem needs adding.

contexts.evidence: Appropriate historical attribution: §4, pp. 234–238, develops the generalized integrals associated with Hellinger. notes: Replace misc plus journal-in-note with a structured article record; current author/title/year/page information is substantively correct.
